payload.claim: After this fix lands, `saffron migrate` will still fabricate `READY_FOR_REVIEW`/`MERGE_FAILED` for a kept `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` row carrying a `pr_url`, the same defect shape addressed here for the other two states. The spec explicitly and reasonably defers this ("left for a later spec if it is ever measured as a live disagreement"), so this is purely an awareness item for the operator, not a defect in this spec.
